causal_edges.meaning: Setter item 0x48 or 0x73 writes exactly its two-bit inventory slot; getter reads same bank; setter returns prior value. Legal new states 0..3; do not generalize to arbitrary input because exported setter does not mask param_2.
Refresh clears skill mask then reads twelve learned states in fixed order, OR only state==1. IDs 0x48..0x4f,0x06,0x73..0x75 map bits 0..11. States 2/3 are not learned.
Animation-end bit item+0xe bit7 plus player flag guard and skill bit0 allow call to charge init; ordinary swing/beam branch services also execute in this routine.

Requires valid attached sword actor, held equipped input, grounded/allowed player state. Writes actor kind 13, action 2 and timer 80 or 40 from skill bit9; calls animation(0x168) then effect(0x43,0,0).
Action 2 countdown only after held/interrupt/cancellation guards; timer reaches 0 → action 3 and ready flag. Preserve byte wrapping and guard order.
Ready phase polls interruption before held-loss or forced-release bit0x80; then spin transition.
Sets action4, animation0x124 or300, Link timer30, pose6, technique flags; terrain-refresh conditional precedes sound0x76.
Spin completion depends on animation update/event bits. Greatspin and beam branches remain visible service-dependent scope extensions.
Cleanup clears charge, sword handle and relevant Link timer/flags then calls item.release. Deleting entity and releasing item context are separate operations.

alias_requirements: All inventory calls and refresh share one bank; preserve packed adjacent slots and old-value return.
skill_mask at player block+0xac aliases charge readers; never copy independent cached masks across routines.

player.sword_handle resolves one canonical live sword actor: charge writes actor+0x40 through the same handle later used by attachment/contact/cleanup. Preserve entity generation/lifetime; null cannot become a padded dummy.
Link entity timers/flags are shared with movement and native action scheduler; native state projections must alias the same owner.
Equipped item IDs at native 0x02002af4/0x02002af5 and held mask 0x03004010 are input state, not cloned item-local flags. First matching A slot wins if both contain the same item.
order_requirements: Learning transaction precedes refresh; refresh precedes legal-action read. Trainer event delivery/save serialization are not recovered.
One native gameplay update per action dispatch; an action transition does not recursively consume the next action countdown in the same update.
Animation event clock is mechanically necessary: it gates charge entry and spin completion. Rendering cannot be stubbed wholesale.
Maintain held versus fresh input distinctions, interruption side effects, exact call ordering and byte-width arithmetic.
Release item ownership once; do not clear an entity handle before required owner-sensitive services or confuse scheduler nonreturning destruction with pointer deletion.
symbolic_contract.units_frames: Timers count native gameplay updates, not seconds/render frames. Item slot enum is 0/1. Actor type/kind numeric values require typed meaning, not HP damage.

mechanic.trigger: Dispatcher at0x0801f5f0 selects table0x082a99ec by actor byte+0x0f. Slot0 selects0x0801f608; under e=2,f=0 it changes f=1 and immediately invokes0x0801f674. Slot1 independently selects0x0801f674.
ordering: Entry0x0801f608: if signed acceleration*velocity<0 set velocity0; state-dependent animation choice; under e=2,f=0 store f=1 and same-tick air step.
0x0801f674: optional animation transition based on actor+be,+115,+73.
0x08016d78: read command ring at actor+0x130+u8(actor+0x12e); if bits0x0c nonzero update facing byte+0x44 and flag bit0x10 at+0x0a; add signed horizontal magnitude+0x54 times sign to x+0x4c.
0x0801a0a4 receives aliasing subviews actor+0x4c and actor+0xc4, same shape pointer from+0x108, facing and literal1,1.
Read current vertical velocity+0x58; add it to y+0x50 BEFORE gravity update; call0x080191b4 on same subviews and shape; retain returned contact result.
Query0x0801c1e8(actor,shape), store low byte at+0x11c; compute acceleration magnitude0x40-trunc(percent*0x20/100) for percent<100, otherwise0x20; sign follows preexisting acceleration sign.

Compute new velocity=oldVelocity+acceleration; derive limit0x800-trunc(percent*0x400/100) for percent<100 else0x400; clamp preserving source signed/unsigned boundary logic, cap positive limit at0x7ff; write+0x58.

If saved contact result !=0: copy current state bytes into history+bc,+bd,+c1,+c2,+c3; set major state+d=0 and e/f=0 when ring bits0x0c clear, else e/f=1; clear+be,+bf,+c0; on clear ring branch clear+0x54 and invoke0x08016dc4; other branch sets+0x54=0x200 or0x280 based on enhancement flag+0x17a and shared input bit0x8000. Invoke0x08001eac(6).

ordered_rules: Read selector = parent+0xcc. Pressed Up decrements signed row byte, then Down increments; wrap negative to 4 and >4 to 0.
Pressed B chooses cancellation after vertical row update. Otherwise clear low nibble of flags; Right increments signed column halfword then Left decrements, wrap >19 to 0 then <0 to 19.

Any directional edge invokes sound 0x51, then display helpers run. A checks availability(column*5+row). Rejected: sound 0x54, no child. Accepted: sound 0x50, allocate child, write selected index to child.state+4 and mode=3 to child.state+0x6f.
Accepted parent writes row|=0x10, flags=(flags&0x0f)|0x10, parent completion byte=0, next callback=0x08025e21. Held Right then held Left update low flags nibble, so Left wins simultaneous hold.

On parent completion, 0x08025e20 uses selector+3 as index, quotient/remainder by 5 restores column/row, callback returns to selection. Provenance of selector+3 and child completion signaling remains unresolved.

rules: held = KEYINPUT XOR 0x03ff; pressed = held & ~previousHeld; repeatMask cleared each call.

16 byte lanes at 0x03001998: released lane resets; continuously held lane increments byte, emits repeat at values 1,16,20; 20 resets to17. Fresh press does not increment/reset its lane in shown branch.
previousHeld published after loop; consumers must share this one sampled snapshot. Counter units are calls; frame cadence not dynamically proven.

mechanic_closure.name: Priority and speed action ordering with shared turn roll and tie-only PRNG
mechanic_closure.scope: Static dependency/causal map; no executable-ready or whole battle claim.
causal_chain: Turn setup producers initialize shared turn_roll via RNG. Their lifecycle context/order must be retained.
Comparator asks weather suppression service, then computes each battler effective speed from speed, weather-sensitive ability and stage ratio.
Apply conditional badge 110/100, item half, paralysis quarter, then shared-roll item override to unsigned maximum in that exact order.

Select move or forced fallback or no move; compare signed priority before effective speed. Equal priority and speed consumes RNG once and returns tie swap code 2 when bit0 is set; slower first battler returns 1; otherwise 0.
Scheduler iterates pair comparisons in original order and swaps BOTH action-order and battler-order lanes on nonzero result; callback selects downstream action dispatcher.

Mode bit 4 clear: call wait-indicator update 0x0800550c first, then accept (remapped new & 3)!=0 and issue sound 5 via 0x080722e0. Mode bit 4 set: use timed gate 0x0800561c instead.

Acknowledgement calls 0x08004470 at PC 0x08005c9a, using window id byte +4 and background nibble byte +0xd. Then cursor.x(+8)=origin.x(+6), cursor.y(+9)=origin.y(+7), state(+0x1c)=0. Next invocation can decode following token.

static_causal_chain.effect: In decode state 0, token 0xfb sets byte text.state(+0x1c)=2 and calls 0x080054dc at PC 0x08005b40; exits with status 3.
At outer loop iteration, active-low input XOR 0x3ff produces raw held; raw new=held & ~previous. Repeat seed/delay uses raw equality. Publish remapped held/new after repeat, then previous raw last.
In state 2 call 0x08005648 at PC 0x08005c82; only a nonzero return permits continuation.
Mode bit 4 clear: call wait-indicator update 0x0800550c first, then accept (remapped new & 3)!=0 and issue sound 5 via 0x080722e0. Mode bit 4 set: use timed gate 0x0800561c instead.

Acknowledgement calls 0x08004470 at PC 0x08005c9a, using window id byte +4 and background nibble byte +0xd. Then cursor.x(+8)=origin.x(+6), cursor.y(+9)=origin.y(+7), state(+0x1c)=0. Next invocation can decode following token.

For nonzero occupied slot, equality returns 0xfffe; if four occupied unequal slots return 0xffff. Return types inferred from uses despite void pseudo-C signatures.
UI state 9 tests return as signed short against -1 (0xffff), requesting replacement route on full slots; exact handling of 0xfffe must remain caller-specific.
UI state 0x1d: slot==4 cancels replacement, otherwise read old move name, call 0x08041078(record,slot) then 0x0803e978(record,newMove,slot), publish success result 0x020370c0=1 and advance state.
Replacement writes selector slot+0xd, then selector slot+0x11 from moveData[move].byte0. Each selector access performs record decrypt/validate/mutate/rechecksum/encrypt as applicable.

No held bits: direction low halfword=0 and repeatTicks=0. Same direction mask 0xf0: increment repeatTicks only while <50. Changed direction mask: save held&0xf0 and set repeatTicks=1.

repeatTicks==1 emits (direction&0xf0)|pressed. repeatTicks==48 first rewrites count to43 then emits same mask. Other counts emit zero, including non-direction new presses unless count condition holds. Do not simplify repeated=pressed every tick.

On held mask 2/0x100 counter increments while signed counter<100. On release: unsigned u16(counter-2)<10 sets corresponding short-release bit, then clears counter. This means counter range2..11; thresholds are sample counts, not seconds.

0x080048d0 clears published repeat, direction and repeatTicks; counters set999 suppress immediate short-release. 0x080048f8 clears only pressed lanes in published/accumulated/current stages.

causal_closure.accepted_hit: If protection bit0200 clear and actor control+66 bit3 clear: shared resource=max(resource-5,0); emit number effect at actor integer x +/-15,y-60 (style1); set flags0200; set protectionTimer110; invoke service08091634(4,-1). Resource saturation threshold<6 implements exact max(resource-5,0).
causal_closure.expiry: 08013620 if world mask1 clear calls08013668 first, then increments u8 protectionTimer if<121; when new timer>120 clears flags0200. A hit initialized110 therefore requires11 eligible update calls for expiry. In owner ordering, expiry precedes current hazard query and can permit a same-update hit. Units are eligible update invocations; native frame rate unproven.
causal_closure.closure_edge: hazard -> accepted hit -> flag blocks repeat hit -> timer -> clears same flag -> hit eligible again
causal_closure.unproven: Resource meaning (health suggested, not established), hazard identity, normal play reachability, native timing, complete actor scheduler and terminal outcome.
